actions.confirm: Copies the books that are not in the library yet into the books-library folder, using room for a second copy of them. Your own books folder is not changed. It can take a while: about 3 seconds a book. Continue?
actions.label: Make the library

author: TheMightyTRexUK

added: **Calibre library maker:** makes a Calibre library from your books folder, in a new books-library folder, so Calibre-Web has something to open. It never changes your books, says what it will do first, shows progress, lists files it could not read and can be run again.

description: Makes a Calibre library from the books in your books folder, in a new folder beside it, so Calibre-Web has something to open. Your own books are never changed.
name: Calibre library maker

settings.hint: Shows what it will do first: how many books, how much room and how long. Your books folder is never changed.
settings.label: Make a Calibre library from your books
